fields.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
fields.note: Most elements are in D041: the utility add-on removal, the dependent 10% removal, the 10% for a non-dependent tenant within 60 days, LAHD-approval programs, the market-reset events, the $1.61 registration pass-through, the $3.00 smoke detector surcharge, the 2020-2024 prohibition, and the 30-day notice for the $1.61 surcharge. D041 does not state the 3% rate for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026, the $2.83 SCEP amount, the 'only after registers and gives written notice' condition, or the state-law 30-day notice for increases under 10%.

fields.quoted_span: A $3.00 surcharge may be added to the rent for the installation and cost of a hard-wired
fields.note: D041 supports once-per-12-months increases, no utility add-on, no dependent 10% add-on from 2/2/2026, 10% for an additional non-dependent tenant within 60 days, the $1.61 RSO surcharge, and the $3.00 smoke detector surcharge. It does not state the 3% rate or the $2.83/month SCEP amount; it only says the landlord may collect 1/12 of 50% of the annual SCEP fee.

fields.quoted_span: Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.
fields.note: The 2026-02-02 date matches the document's statement of when the current formula took effect. The document does not give the RSO's original effective date, and the rule does not claim one.

fields.note: The page is current (September 2026) and presents the RSO as presently applicable, consistent with in_force.

fields.note: The cutoff date, 'first built' basis, replacement units under LAMC 151.28, covered property types, the condo/townhome 12/31/1995 limitation, the luxury exemption, and temporary exemptions are all supported. The supersedes_state_rule=true flag is not stated in D041; it comes from D040.
D041 never cites L.A. Mun. Code § 151.06. It cites only LAMC Section 151.28 and 151.09.C.9 and 165.05.B.5. The rule's own review_note acknowledges that the section is unverified.
